title: Implement the minimum development-time task contract

requirement.summary: Continue development from the corrected plan by governing coding-agent work before and during implementation.

objective.rationale: This is the first product-defining P0 slice after correcting the PR-center architecture drift.

goal: Provide a strict, read-only, vendor-neutral contract that bounds one coding-agent development task.
non_goals: Do not compare Git changes with the admitted scope in this slice.
Do not automatically select or judge architecture relevance.
Do not implement completion reconciliation, hooks, commits, or remote writes.
acceptance_signals: A valid admitted task produces deterministic PASS findings and an explicit objective-alignment ADVISORY.
Missing requirement provenance or architecture context remains visible without being mislabeled as objective failure.
Invalid structure, unsafe references, and inconsistent admission or approval states fail deterministically.
The task check does not modify repository files, Git state, branches, or remote systems.
Focused and complete test suites pass.

items: A premature schema could overfit AgentGov or turn semantic judgment into deterministic policy.
Adding the task check to repository-wide validation before its interface is proven could expand the stable contract too early.

stop_conditions: Stop if the contract requires AgentGov to infer human intent or architecture quality as an objective fact.
Stop if the slice needs repository writes, Git mutation, runtime hooks, or expanded external authority.
Stop if existing unrelated worktree changes cannot be preserved.

decision.rationale: The user explicitly requested continued development according to the corrected P0 plan. The delivered task was paused on 2026-08-05 to remove it from automatic discovery; this is routing hygiene, not a claim of semantic completion, acceptance, merge, or release.
